findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 37 requests to 13 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 60.4 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 4.4 MB (7%) came from third-party domains, 220 kB of it from services classified as tracking (7 requests).

3 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), imasdk.googleapis.com (Google, advertising).
1 cookies were set by third-party domains (16 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Strict-Transport-Security header.
